-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Heavenly Ice Fang.png  |title= Ice Magic |kanji= 氷魔法 |romaji= Kōri Mahō |english= Ice Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Cabra (Anime) #Heath Graice #Lucius Zogratis #Mariella #Nils Ragus #Rhya (Anime) #Wainsley #Xerx Lugner #Unnamed elf #Unnamed Spade Kingdom soldier (Anime) }} {{Nihongo|Ice Magic|氷魔法|Kōri Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate ice. It is derived from the Water Magic attribute.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate ice at will. Without the use of a grimoire, the users are still able to use this magic. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells a
    Reflected spells could be melted before hitting the users.
    Ice Magic is considered weak against Fire Magic.{{Clr}}
